project.title: Source Completeness & Traceability Lens
project.subtitle: Standalone Oracle roadmap · SCTL as new independent Word-to-Table application tab
project.aim: 100% traceability at source level: reveal original DOCX content that was not captured, partially captured, altered, excluded, unsupported or uncertain. Show omissions directly on authentic source pages. Traceability and disclosure, not conversion repair; never claim 100% capture.

M1.name: P1 — Missing Source Lens
M1.full: WBS 1.1: Add a fourth top-level Source Traceability tab inside Word-to-Table prototype/ (beside Tables, CAPS, Word/HTML diff). On authentic R5 evidence visually highlight the missing Notes table at the original source page; click for exact identity, target evidence and uncertainty. No converter repair.
M1.canDo: Native P1 task issue recorded; new application tab not yet built, verified or Owner-tried.
M1.activity: Scope corrected: new independent app tab; native task issue #6; no integrated candidate

M2.name: P2 — Source Census Lens
M2.full: WBS 1.2: Extend the accepted Source Traceability tab within Word-to-Table to census all original source pages, inventory tables/paragraphs and show capture/unresolved statuses. Preserve the P1 tab and existing Tables/CAPS/Word/HTML diff behavior.
M2.canDo: P2 is the connected second card, not yet released.

M3.name: P3 — Visual Blind-Spot Lens
M3.full: WBS 1.3: Independently reveal visible source regions not explained by structural inventory; a removed annotation must trigger visible unknown coverage rather than false 100%. Provisional pending P1/P2 Owner trials. Extend the existing SCTL tab; do not make a separate product.
M3.canDo: P3 outcome planned; scope may be re-sliced from Owner tests.

M4.name: P4 — Source Review Lens
M4.full: WBS 1.4: Select unknown source regions, classify and record evidence, export/import review decisions bound to input hashes; no conversion repair. Provisional. Extend the existing SCTL tab; preserve converter state.
M4.canDo: P4 outcome planned; reviewer workflow not implemented.

M5.name: P5 — Static Evidence Release
M5.full: WBS 1.5: Include the preserved SCTL tab in Word-to-Table's existing prototype/ Pages build plus offline equivalent. Test hosted/offline behavior, private-evidence exclusion and independently falsify source identity/omission claims; no separate application deployment.
M5.canDo: P5 publication not authorized; no release candidate.
